The long tail matters for governance: **289 records sit in no collection** (the `None` orphan bucket), and many products exist as a single layer. These are exactly the datasets [`DS-002`](rule_book.qmd#ds-002) is designed to catch. The full download set (`downloadable: No`) is concentrated in **WorldClim-v2.1** and **eBird** — the two biggest products — which [`DS-004`](rule_book.qmd#ds-004) flags for an explicit access decision.
